title: a one-component inspector run clears no finding trouble
intention: A build-inspector run over one component clears no finding trouble; only a run that saw every component reconciles.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: _main in cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py narrows inspect to the named component, then reconciles the whole inspector-new-finding- prefix against those findings. A finding trouble is one per sieve (cd27b72ba964), so a sieve still firing at another component would be cleared while its cause stands (Law 7).
traces_to: Law 7: a record of truth may not collapse an error into silence; a trouble cleared while its cause stands is that collapse.
how: _main calls _reconcile_cleared_findings only when no component was named; raises are unchanged. A red-first proof drives _main with a scripted inspect, an empty scratch baseline and a recording raiser.

clauses.claim: a one-component run emits no reconcile, so a trouble for a sieve firing at another component is left standing
the whole-repo run still reconciles, handing trouble every sieve above baseline
a one-component run still raises the trouble of its own above-baseline finding

decisions.text: D1: _main reconciles only on the whole-repo run.
D2: a red-first proof, one tooth per clause, nothing reaching the live trouble lane.

measured.saw: inspect(component=X) keeps only X's census rows, and _main passes those findings to _reconcile_cleared_findings, which reconciles the inspector-new-finding- prefix

red on origin/main: _main(['tools/testing-044a']) reconciled ('inspector-new-finding-', ['inspector-new-finding-component-color']), so encapsulation-holds, firing at devices/testing-044b, would be cleared; teeth 2 and 3 green
measured.how: the proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_a_one_component_run_clears_no_other_components_trouble.py run under bin/cairn test --exec against origin/main
